product.name: AI-Powered Customer Conversation Analysis
product.description: Analyzes 100% of customer conversations across chat, email, and voice to identify agent behaviors, pitfalls, and automation opportunities.

product.name: AI Agent Training and Deployment
product.description: Builds AI agents trained on top-performing human agents’ workflows, tone, and compliance rules to automate customer interactions.

product.name: Simulated Testing of AI Agents
product.description: Conducts rigorous testing of AI agents using simulated users trained on real data to identify errors and edge cases before live deployment.

product.name: Integration with Customer Experience Platforms
product.description: Integrates AI agents and analytics with popular customer experience tools like Intercom, Zendesk, and Salesforce.
